answer: A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The juniper counter is kept in atlas and sparrow exposes each reset. An attacker as a result has to keep each alias continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1494 identities would post 2110 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
